name: IdempotentStamp
note: Baselines are regression references. A visual change re-writes them with --approve and needs critic approval (system rule).

critic.notes: Lite stills only (hashes match meta). Verb reads: envelope with key leaves outbox, stamp seals the ledger once (green seal, one row filled), later copy stops at the seal with warn ring, ghost row, pips. No blocking item. Weak: stamp strike and rebound never visible in a still, key glyph on envelopes tiny, right quarter and bottom dead, p0 empty, no motion strip, outbox arrow ambiguous. Standard/hero stills and a strike/rebound strip required before final lock.
